payload.summary: Plan revision 2 (approved by operator): incorporated Databricks multi-million-line coding-agent benchmark insights. A1: scoring cost term switched to success-adjusted observed cost-per-completed-task posterior (per-Mtok price prior-only). A2: feedback source weights reordered - deterministic verification outcomes above LLM-judged gen-eval scores. A3: dashboard headline metric is cost-per-completed-task. A4 logged as deferred task DT-1 (internal task-derived benchmark). No DAG/contract/package changes.

decisions.title: Cost term = success-adjusted cost-per-completed-task posterior
decisions.rationale: Databricks: Sonnet 5 ~1.7x cheaper per token than Opus 4.8 yet $2.09 vs $1.94 per completed task at 81% vs 87% completion - token price inverts real rankings

decisions.title: Deterministic verification outcomes outweigh LLM-judged scores in posteriors
decisions.rationale: Databricks graded via held-out tests, no LLM judge: judging rewards sounding right over being right; gen-eval semantic_judge is an LLM judge
